title: AWS Marketplace onboarding playbook — prep notes
summary: Scratchpad for a short 1:1 + follow-up with AWS marketplace partner manager — focus on onboarding checklist, billing contract points, and integration blockers.
content:
Context:
- Quick prep for 1:1 with AWS Marketplace partner manager (Tues 11:00 PT). Lina running the channel motion for marketplaces, Alex is technical lead, Priya owns commercial ops.
- Goal: unblock onboarding to Accelerate program, align on billing contract cadence, validate listing assets + EULA items, and confirm next steps for private offers.

Agenda (25–30m):
1) Quick intros & goals (3m) — why Redwood marketplace matters for infra customers
2) Listing status + required artifacts (5m) — logos, architecture diagram, SAQ, pricing matrix
3) Billing & pricing mechanics (6m) — metered billing vs. fixed subscription; invoicing cadences; test purchases
4) Technical integration blockers (6m) — deployment manifest, telemetry/usage reporting, sandbox account access
5) Next steps & owners (5m)

Notes to self / talking points:
- Emphasize our unique selling point: inference performance guarantees and predictable unit economics (talk about batching + caching features briefly).
- For customers: want 14-day free trial provisioning through AWS console — confirm if AWS Accelerate supports that flow or need a private offer.
- Risk: legal may want additional data residency language for some EU customers — ping security/compliance early.
- Ask AWS about "test purchase" flow: is there a sandbox or can we script a low-value purchase to validate billing pipeline?
- Clarify fees: AWS Marketplace transaction fee vs what we expect. Do we list net or gross pricing?

Unresolved questions to raise:
- Can we do metered billing on per-token basis or must we map to subscription SKUs? If metered, what's the latency of usage reporting AWS expects?
- Who at AWS owns the Accelerate intake queue? Any specific SLAs to push listings through faster?
- EULA: can we keep our standard EULA + small addendum, or must we use AWS-provided contract templates?
- Are there profiling/marketing opportunities (webinars, co-marketing credits) we can tap when listing goes live?

Quick checklist (what to have prepared before call):
- [ ] Draft listing copy (2 variants: technical + business) — Alex to review API/feature bullets
- [ ] Architecture diagram (single page) — Alex to produce
- [ ] Pricing matrix (metered tiers + enterprise fixed) — Priya to draft
- [ ] Compliance checklist + contact for legal review (GDPR/KMS) — Lina to confirm contact in security team
- [ ] Test purchase script or steps documented — Devrel/SEs to own

Action items (tracked here so I don't forget):
action_items: Alex Romero: produce one-page architecture diagram and short technical listing bullets — due 2026-03-05
Priya Nair: draft pricing matrix with both metered-per-token and subscription SKU options + suggested list price and expected margins — due 2026-03-04
Lina Chen: loop in Security (Marcel) for GDPR/KMS note and confirm whether extra addendum required for EU customers — due 2026-03-06
Lina Chen: ask AWS partner manager for Accelerate intake owner and test-purchase procedure during 1:1 (Tues 11:00 PT) — immediate
DevRel (TBD): produce a test-purchase runbook and a small automation script to exercise listing purchase flow in sandbox — due 2026-03-12
Priya Nair: confirm invoicing cadence options (monthly vs net-30) and whether AWS supports consolidated invoicing for marketplace sellers — due 2026-03-08
